classification.difficultyReason: Choose triple-angle recognition or polynomial factorisation, reject roots outside the sine range, and recover all permitted angles from each retained root.

content.prompt: Solve the following equations for $0\le x\le2\pi$, as exact values or correct to two decimal places.

answer.worked:
Let $t=\tan x$ and $P(t)=t^3-2t^2-5t+6$. Since $P(1)=0$,
$$\begin{align*}P(t)&=(t-1)(t^2-t-6)\\P(t)&=(t-1)(t-3)(t+2).\end{align*}$$
Thus $\tan x=1,3,-2$. For $0\le x\le2\pi$,
$$\begin{align*}\tan x=1:\quad x&=\frac\pi4,\frac{5\pi}4\\\tan x=3:\quad x&=\tan^{-1}3,\pi+\tan^{-1}3\\\tan x=-2:\quad x&=\pi-\tan^{-1}2,2\pi-\tan^{-1}2.\end{align*}$$
Hence $x=\dfrac\pi4,\dfrac{5\pi}4,1.25,4.39,2.03,5.18$, with non-exact values rounded to two decimal places.

Let $u=\sin x$ and $P(u)=3u^3-7u^2+4$. Since $P(1)=0$,
$$\begin{align*}P(u)&=(u-1)(3u^2-4u-4)\\P(u)&=(u-1)(3u+2)(u-2).\end{align*}$$
Thus $\sin x=1,-\dfrac23,2$. Reject $\sin x=2$ because $-1\le\sin x\le1$.
Let $\alpha=\sin^{-1}\!\left(\dfrac23\right)$. For $0\le x\le2\pi$,
$$\begin{align*}\sin x=1:\quad x&=\frac\pi2\\\sin x=-\frac23:\quad x&=\pi+\alpha,2\pi-\alpha.\end{align*}$$
Hence $x=\dfrac\pi2,3.87,5.55$, with non-exact values rounded to two decimal places.

Let $t=\tan x$ and $P(t)=t^3+3t^2-10t-24$. Since $P(3)=0$,
$$\begin{align*}P(t)&=(t-3)(t^2+6t+8)\\P(t)&=(t-3)(t+2)(t+4).\end{align*}$$
Thus $\tan x=-4,-2,3$. For $0\le x\le2\pi$,
$$\begin{align*}\tan x=-4:\quad x&=\pi-\tan^{-1}4,2\pi-\tan^{-1}4\\\tan x=-2:\quad x&=\pi-\tan^{-1}2,2\pi-\tan^{-1}2\\\tan x=3:\quad x&=\tan^{-1}3,\pi+\tan^{-1}3.\end{align*}$$
Hence $x=1.82,4.96,2.03,5.18,1.25,4.39$, correct to two decimal places.
